verdict.rationale: No evidence describes retention settings or deletion controls. The only support is indirect: the documented self-hosting options (including Docker Compose) let a user keep logged data on their own infrastructure, which gives de facto control over how long it is kept and when it is removed. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods on the hosted service, request/log deletion API or UI, account-level data purge, and independent corroboration of any of these.
